summary: Spire Inc. (filer) via its wholly-owned subsidiary Spire Resources LLC completed the sale of all membership interests of Spire Marketing Inc. to Boardwalk Pipelines LP for $215.0 million in cash, subject to customary post-closing adjustments. The transaction was previously disclosed in a March 30, 2026 8-K. Closing occurred on April 30, 2026 after satisfaction of conditions including conversion of Spire Marketing to a Delaware LLC and regulatory approvals. No board recommendation or advisor named. The filing is a completion notice; watch for post-closing working capital adjustments and any impact on Spire's financials.
